map.色觉(Ishihara)假同色图测试器 使用指南: Color Vision (Ishihara) Pseudoisochromatic Plate Tester User Guide
map.观察每张伪同色图中的数字并选择答案。色觉正常者可读出全部数字，红绿色觉异常者会读: Observe the number in each pseudoisochromatic plate and choose the answer. People with normal color vision can read all the numbers, while those with red-green deficiency misread or cannot read them. This tool is a screening version, not a diagnostic tool.
map.阅读假同色图数字，按答对 plate 数判读色觉。: Read the numbers on the pseudoisochromatic plates and interpret color vision by the number of plates answered correctly.
map.：正确率高，色觉基本正常；仅 1 错可能为偶然。: : High accuracy, color vision essentially normal; a single error may be chance.
map.：大量误读，强烈提示红绿色觉缺陷，建议进一步色觉专项检查。: : Many plates misread, strongly suggesting red-green color vision deficiency; further specialized color vision testing is recommended.
map.几岁可做？: From what age can it be done?
map.一般 4–5 岁以上能识数即可，幼儿用图形版。: Generally children aged 4-5 and above who can recognize numbers can do it; use the picture version for younger children.
map.全错一定是色盲？: Does getting everything wrong definitely mean color blindness?
map.也可能是不配合/不识数，需结合其他检查确认。: It may also be poor cooperation or inability to recognize numbers; confirm with other tests.
